title: Memory Update Outside the Marked Region
statement: Let $b,K,v\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $M:\mathbb{Z}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be memory contents. If $v<K$, then changing the memory value at cell $b+v$ to true leaves every cell other than $b+u$ for $u<K$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ maps integer cell positions to Boolean values
